product.name: Apozy Airlock - Browser Defense Platform
product.description: A browser defense platform that disarms dangerous websites at the time of click using native browser isolation to protect users from online threats such as phishing and malware.

product.name: Airlock - Native Browser Isolation
product.description: A browser extension providing native sandboxing to isolate users from malicious websites and online threats instantly without requiring proxies or additional infrastructure.

product.name: Apozy Visual Threat Database API
product.description: An API that allows integration of real-time malicious URL detection into existing security tools using a large visual threat database.
